data.one_liner: Flutter library exposing Unicons icon set as IconData and widget classes.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to the Unicons line and solid icon sets via IconData constants and optional widget wrappers. Icons are auto‑generated from the latest Unicons release.
use_when: You need a large collection of free icons for a Flutter app
You want both line and solid variants of the same icon set
You prefer a single dependency for all icons rather than multiple icon packs
avoid_when: You require custom or brand‑specific icons not included in Unicons
You need to modify icon shapes at runtime
strengths: Auto‑generated code keeps icons up to date
Supports both IconData and Widget usage
weaknesses: No support for custom icon files
No theming or color customization beyond IconData properties
Large package size due to many icons
data.setup_notes: Add `unicons: any` to pubspec and run `flutter pub get`
